notes: Cropping is a computer job now: type the exact start and end to a tenth of a second, nudge either edge a second at a time, or click the waveform to drop the nearest edge there.

The crop sheet is wider, its grab handles are nearly twice as wide, and the keyboard does the rest - arrows nudge the edge you last touched, Shift moves a whole second, Space previews and Enter saves.

Every song can carry its own speed: tap the chip on the now bar to step through 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x, 0.75x and 0.5x, or set an exact rate in the song own rack. It is remembered per song, the pitch is kept, and every other song stays at 1x.
Searching the open catalogue and playing a streamed song work in a browser again, not only in the Android app.
